proposed_from.topic: Outcome-dependent delayed-feedback phase diagram for adaptive causal contrasts. For horizons T and two arms, observe bounded iid potential outcomes under predictable logged allocation, with one prespecified arm having assignment probability comparable to t^(-alpha), alpha in [0,1), and finite arm-specific delays jointly distributed with outcomes but satisfying a known polynomial tail envelope. Determine the minimax expected-length order max{T^(-(1-alpha)/2),T^(-beta)} for uniformly honest intervals for the arm-mean contrast; prove a matching same-experiment converse, the ordinary-Wald versus hidden-tail boundary, and the attained bounded-shift Gaussian calibration. Construct a measurable two-cohort AIPW/HT procedure with an observable variance gate and concentration fallback, and show when Liberali et al.'s delayed-endpoint real-time adaptive cardiovascular-trial intervals require a tail pad or extended follow-up. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: An independent-arm-tape reduction and deterministic quota design yield a derived two-cohort construction: a large cohort estimates rewards revealed by age T^rho, while an early cohort estimates the newly revealed tail. The correction variance is lower order when rho beta>(1-rho)(1-alpha), leaving contrast bias at most 2L T^(-beta)(1+o(1)); rho=3/4 works at the boundary. A Rademacher hidden-sign family attains the folded-normal envelope. Checks covered adaptive stopping, nonconvergent allocation scaling, shrinking variance, infinite-delay exclusions, and collisions with Bai-Hu-Rosenberger, Lancewicki et al., and Armstrong-Kolesar. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove the uniform studentized two-cohort approximation, including the observable variance gate at 1/log T and its fallback, without conditioning on quota success or assuming propensity convergence. EARLY KILL TEST: Prove the fixed-quota arm-tape equivalence and the old-tail correction variance bound in a finite-support policy that switches after an early reward; pivot if it requires reward-delay independence or conditioning on recruitment success. Exact global minimax constants are deliberately left open.","selected_kernel":"A fixed-quota, follow-up-indexed two-cohort interval for an eventual arm-mean contrast has minimax expected length \\(\\max\\{T^{-(1-\\alpha)/2},(1+T+\\Delta_T)^{-\\beta}\\}\\) under arbitrary outcome-delay dependence, and uniform ordinary-Wald validity over the envelope class is characterized by the tail-envelope-to-standard-error frontier, without excluding pointwise validity for prompt-delay laws.","strict_delta":"The new mathematical object is the joint phase map in \\((\\alpha,\\beta,\\Delta_T)\\), certified by an unconditional arm-tape upper construction on recorded revelation times and same-policy observed-filtration lower experiments; at \\(\\Delta_T=0\\) it yields the headline frontier."}

seed_details.anchor: ShiWangWu2023DelayedInference, Theorems 4.1--4.3 and Corollary 4.4; LancewickiSegalKorenMansour2021, Section 4 and Theorem 6
seed_details.opportunity: Derive the minimax honest-interval length \(\max\{T^{-(1-\alpha)/2},T^{-\beta}\}\) when delay and outcome may be dependent, using a same-policy likelihood comparison and a two-cohort upper construction.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The DAIPW score is no longer conditionally centered because revelation selects outcomes; replace the martingale centering step by an observed-law arm-tape representation and deterministic prefix quotas.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for outcome-dependent delayed adaptive confidence intervals, reward-dependent delayed inference, and two-cohort delayed estimators located regret results and delay-independent inference, but no matching honest-interval phase diagram.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Shi, Wang, and Wu because their Corollary 4.4 already combines polynomial exploration and polynomial delays.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their centering uses outcome-delay independence and therefore deletes the hidden-tail mean shift; their theorem gives no informative-delay lower bound or \(T^{-\beta}\) honest-length term.

seed_details.opportunity: Prove a uniform studentized limit for overlapping main and old cohorts, with an observable variance gate and a concentration branch that remains honest when variance collapses.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The conditional-standard-deviation estimator no longer targets a centered score; first remove the predictable stopping clock by fixed arm-tape quotas, then compare the old-cohort correction in \(L_2\) to the main-prefix standard error.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for studentization with informative delayed outcomes and adaptive allocation found conditional-variance stabilization under prompt or independent-delay observation, not a measurable gate spanning Gaussian and degenerate regimes.
seed_details.red_team: A variance gate is a routine splice of a martingale central limit theorem and Bernstein's inequality.
seed_details.rebuttal: Uniform validity across a random shrinking-variance boundary, with overlapping cohorts and no conditioning on quota success, is precisely where the existing high-level variance-convergence arguments do not apply.

seed_details.opportunity: Characterize ordinary-Wald honesty if and only if \(T^{(1-\alpha)/2}(T+\Delta_T)^{-\beta}\to0\), and identify the bounded-shift and coverage-collapse regimes otherwise.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The usual Slutsky step must retain, rather than discard, the tail mean as a deterministic local shift and must exhibit a compatible hidden-sign law attaining each boundary shift.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing adaptive cardiovascular trials, outcome-dependent ascertainment, extended follow-up, and Wald coverage found simulation and independent-delay asymptotics but no necessary-and-sufficient follow-up frontier.
seed_details.red_team: The condition is immediate from comparing a bias bound with a standard error.
seed_details.rebuttal: Sufficiency is only half the result; necessity requires same-observed-experiment laws and an attained local shifted-Gaussian limit under the adaptive log.

seed_details.anchor: CookMishlerRamdas2024, Section 3 and the betting confidence-sequence theorem; HowardRamdasMcAuliffeSekhon2021, Theorem 1
seed_details.opportunity: Construct a time-uniform confidence sequence with width \(\max\{\sqrt{\log\log t/t^{1-\alpha}},t^{-\beta}\}\) up to necessary stitching factors under informative delays.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The test-supermartingale must be built for revealed, fixed-age scores and then combined with a simultaneous deterministic tail envelope; the pending outcomes themselves are not martingale increments.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for confidence sequences under reward-dependent delays found prompt-outcome adaptive AIPW sequences and generic martingale stitching, but no informative-delay hidden-tail sequence.
seed_details.red_team: Attach \(t^{-\beta}\) to Cook, Mishler, and Ramdas and apply a union bound.
seed_details.rebuttal: A pointwise tail pad is not simultaneous, and cohort ages change with calendar time; optional stopping can select the largest noncentered tail unless a joint construction is proved.

seed_details.anchor: MaWangWei2026CARA, Theorem 1 and Section 6; LiberaliEtAl2025RTAR, Sections 1 and 5
seed_details.opportunity: Choose an exploration floor and post-recruitment follow-up schedule to minimize worst-case interval length plus a patient-welfare cost, with a KKT or saddle-point certificate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the delay-independent efficient-variance objective by a bias-aware objective containing the adversarial hidden-tail modulus, then optimize jointly over allocation and follow-up.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for optimal adaptive trial design with informative delayed endpoints found forward-looking allocation under conditional delay-outcome independence and simulation-based RTAR, not a certified inference-follow-up optimum.
seed_details.red_team: This is a routine scalar optimization once the interval rate is known.
seed_details.rebuttal: The allocation changes both the adaptive information process and the hidden-tail exposure; a valid certificate must optimize over feasible predictable policies rather than over a postulated effective sample size.

seed_details.opportunity: Derive sharp propensity-weighted bounds for the arm contrast when delays may be infinite and informative, with uniform inference for the bound endpoints.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace point identification by an extremal completion of never-revealed outcomes and prove that predictable Horvitz--Thompson empirical distributions recover the observed components.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for adaptive logged assignment paired with informative permanent missingness located generic missing-data bounds and delayed-bandit regret, but no sharp adaptive causal contrast region.
seed_details.red_team: The bounds are Manski's missing-outcome bounds with propensity weights inserted.
seed_details.rebuttal: The closed-form identification endpoints are close to classical bounds, but simultaneous endpoint inference under a history-dependent assignment log is not automatic; the seed is retained only as a lower-tier alternative.

seed_details.opportunity: Characterize a product lower bound between cumulative regret and honest contrast-interval length under reward-dependent delays, matched by forced exploration.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Couple the regret lower-bound alternative to an inferential two-point alternative while preserving one common informative-delay observation law.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found regret bounds for reward-dependent delays and inference under prompt outcomes, but not their product frontier under a common delayed experiment.
seed_details.red_team: The claimed product is not invariant to the arm gap and the delay law, so a single frontier can be manufactured by parameterization.
seed_details.rebuttal: No canonical normalization survived the scan; without a gap-indexed local parameter space the flagship shape is under-specified.

seed_details.opportunity: Derive a semiparametric efficiency bound for the eventual contrast under informative delays and an attaining adaptive estimator.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The observed-data tangent space must include unrestricted perturbations of the joint outcome-delay law under horizon censoring, so the delay-independent efficient influence function must be reprojected.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination pair is not occupied, but the polynomial envelope alone yields a nonregular horizon-indexed model whose efficiency bound is not a stable scalar object.
seed_details.red_team: There is no regular semiparametric efficiency problem when the hidden-tail bias is of first order.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds on the full envelope class; a regular efficiency question would require a narrower local model and would no longer settle the named frontier.

seed_details.opportunity: Invert a treatment-label permutation test for the eventual contrast while outcomes arrive under an adaptive policy.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: A valid symmetry orbit would have to preserve both the adaptive assignment kernel and the outcome-dependent reveal pattern.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found betting and martingale inversion rather than a treatment-label group action compatible with history-dependent allocation and informative revelation.
seed_details.red_team: Adaptive propensities and informative reveal times destroy the exchangeability required by the proposed permutation orbit.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds without conditioning away the adaptivity, so the seed is rejected rather than rescued by an artificial symmetry assumption.
